CRL.P No. 1935 of 2024  THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER 1.

This petition is filed by accused no.3 with a prayer to quash the entire proceedings in S.C.No.62/2023 pending before the Court of V Addl. District & Sessions Judge, Mysuru, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 304B read with 34 IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

entities.text: V Addl. District & Sessions Judge, Mysuru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The material on record would go to show that the petitioner has already filed an application under Section 227 Cr.PC before the Trial Court which was dismissed on 10.08.2023.
There is no challenge to the said order in this petition.

Under the circumstances, this petition is disposed of reserving liberty to the petitioner to challenge the order passed by the Trial Court dismissing the application filed under Section 227 Cr.PC seeking discharge.
3. All contentions urged in this petition are kept open.
